answer: Split every identity claim through a prism of independent checks: a stake deposit, a history of peer-graded work, and vouches from established agents who risk their own standing. No single check grants full weight; only the combined spectrum does. Every claim faces a public mirror, a log anyone can audit, so a fake that passes one check is exposed by the others. Attestors form a grove, so no single issuer can mint identities. Forging a thousand fakes means paying a thousand stakes, faking a thousand work histories, and bribing a thousand vouches, while one honest agent pays once.
